# ContainerMaxWidth

`Flare.Components.ContainerMaxWidth`

Maximum width constraint applied to layout containers such as FlareContainer and the content area of FlareLayout / FlareLayoutContent. Each value (except Full) caps the width and centers the content horizontally.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Xs` | `0` | Extra small: caps the content at 480px and centers it. |
| `Sm` | `1` | Small: caps the content at 600px and centers it. |
| `Md` | `2` | Medium: caps the content at 960px and centers it. |
| `Lg` | `3` | Large: caps the content at 1280px and centers it. |
| `Xl` | `4` | Extra large: caps the content at 1920px and centers it. |
| `Full` | `5` | No constraint: the content spans the full available width. |

## Used by components

- `FlareContainer`
- `FlareLayoutContent`
